usedFor: Zoho POS holds shoppers as contacts, and “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats greets them when “New Contact Created” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Zoho POS, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new contact gets a template message through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Contact Created” in Zoho POS is polling, so the message goes after a scheduled check.
